Callout.Name: Prowler Reported
Callout.Message: Person trying door handles along a street.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect on foot, no weapon seen, no entry made yet.

Script.Line: I am looking for a house. My friend lives round here somewhere.
I do not know which number. That is why I am trying the handles.
It is a fair thing to do. I am not breaking anything.

Lines.Approach: They are going along the row trying every handle. Nobody has caught them at it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
